notes.title: Mortal Crux to appear in the Endix Indie Showcase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42592995/bae5702e32005ba96b66c2cab74664e6a57e3e48.png[/img]

[b]MORTAL CRUX[/b] will be featured in the [b]Endix Indie Showcase[/b] May 24-25th!

[url=https://endix-expo.com/?snr=1_1056_615_endixindieshowcase_1601]Click here to for details on entering the event![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42592995/7cdd4990813f8f58fd6b4fc9990c667973a2fc74.png[/img]

If you're attending the expo, be sure to stop by the [b]MORTAL CRUX[/b] booth for a chance to win a copy of the game on release! [i](Booth #1 on floor one)[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45584116/sale/EndixIndieShowcase]Click here to check out the Steam pages of games in the event![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42592995/07613e45a574024173e69740bc856ddbc4c23199.png[/img]

If you take any pics/vids/streams of the booth, I'd be happy to see them! Just post [url=https://x.com/MortalCrux]@MortalCrux[/url] on x/Twitter!

[b]Thanks again to everyone keeping up with my work on the project while I continue to make MORTAL CRUX the best game it can be![/b] - [i]Jesse[/i]

notes.title: Mortal Crux to appear in the PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted
notes.content:
[b]Mortal Crux[/b] will be featured in the [b]PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted[/b] showcase at the end of this month!

I'll be revealing new content and features in a special devlog for the show!

The event will air on Thursday, [b]November 30[/b] at [b]10 am PST[/b] (1 pm EST, 6 pm GMT, 7 pm CET) on [b]Twitch[/b], [b]YouTube[/b], [b]Steam[/b], and [b]Bilibili[/b].

"PC Gamer will reveal the voting results of a panel of games industry luminaries including Sid Meier, Tim Schafer, and Brenda Romero." --- [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/pc-gaming-show-most-wanted-will-reveal-the-25-most-exciting-upcoming-pc-games-on-november-30/]Read the event details here![/url]
